tagline: Follow Up. On Point. Because the room is everywhere.

getting_started.title: Getting Started
getting_started.subtitle: Everything you need to get started with FollowOp — from adding the app to your home screen to capturing your first contact.

steps.title: Add to your home screen
steps.body: FollowOp works best when it lives on your home screen. One tap and you're capturing contacts — no app store needed.

platforms.name: iPhone — Safari
steps: Open followop.app in Safari — not Chrome

steps.title: Learn the 4 contact types
steps.body: Every contact gets tagged with one of four types — this tells you and your team exactly what to do next.

types.name: Hot Intro
types.desc: Connect them with someone right now. Urgent.

types.name: Follow Up
types.desc: Reach out yourself this week. Warm lead.

types.name: Recommend
types.desc: Great for a client or colleague.

types.name: Community Intel
types.desc: Good to know. Keep in your network.

steps.title: Capture your first contact
steps.body: Two modes — pick the one that fits the moment.

modes.name: ⚡ Quick Capture — Header Button — 10 Seconds
modes.desc: Tap Quick Capture at the top of the app — always visible. Name and phone or email. Save. Done. Complete their profile later by tapping Edit.
modes.best_for: Busy events, quick handoffs, when you only have seconds

modes.name: ⚡ Hot Intro — Full Capture
modes.desc: Tap Hot Intro in Quick Actions. Fill in all details. Upload a photo from Gallery and AI fills the form automatically.
modes.best_for: When you have a minute, important contacts, client work

steps.tip: Always take photos with your regular camera app first — saves to your camera roll automatically. Then tap Upload from Gallery in FollowOp. Your photo is always safe even if you close the app mid-capture.

input_guide.label: Photo of them
input_guide.desc: reads their energy and personal style

steps.title: Log your first event
steps.body: Logging events connects your contacts and powers your reports. Do this before every event — 30 seconds.

steps.title: Tap Log Event on the dashboard
steps.desc: Find the 📍 button in Quick Actions grid.

steps.title: Enter event name and date
steps.desc: Add venue and which client you are representing.

steps.title: Capture contacts at the event
steps.desc: Select the event from the dropdown — every contact links automatically.

steps.title: After — log your numbers
steps.desc: Conversations, contacts, intros, social posts. ROI score calculated automatically.

steps.title: Read The Room — before you follow up
steps.body: Take a photo of them, upload their LinkedIn screenshot, paste their URL — or use their business card. AI gives you their communication style and a ready-to-send follow-up message. Culturally aware — accounts for relationship-first cultures, communication norms across nationalities, and individual personality signals.

input_guide.label: Photo of them
input_guide.desc: reads their energy, body language, and personal style

input_guide.label: Business card photo
input_guide.desc: reads their professional presence — business intel

input_guide.label: Paste their URL or bio
input_guide.desc: LinkedIn URL, Instagram handle, website, or any text

returns: Their communication personality type — culturally informed
How to speak to them — adjusted for their background and style
What to avoid — specific to this person
A suggested follow-up message — personalized and ready to send
steps.note: Business card = business intel. Photo of them = communication style. Use both for the complete picture. AI results are a starting point — always apply your own judgment.

steps.title: Vibe The Room — before you work it
steps.body: Take a wide photo or panorama of the room. AI reads the crowd, the energy, the opportunity — and tells you exactly how to show up and what to say first.
steps.tip: On iPhone use Panorama mode to sweep the whole room in one shot. Nothing gets saved — just the intelligence. Use as a guide — your own read of the room always takes priority.
returns: The room type and energy level
Who is in the room — industries, seniority, decision makers
Your opportunity — what contacts to prioritize
How to show up — specific advice for this room right now
Your opening line — one perfect conversation starter

steps.title: Research This Contact — know before you call
steps.body: Before following up with anyone — research them. AI searches the web for their full profile, business intel, community affiliations, and recent activity. Culturally aware — adjusts follow-up approach based on cultural context.
steps.note: AI-generated research may be incomplete or outdated. Verify important details before acting. Cultural inferences are generalizations — not absolutes.

steps.title: Protect your data
steps.body: Your contacts live on your device. Export regularly — especially before clearing your browser or switching phones.

exports.name: Export to CSV
exports.desc: Settings → Export Contacts to CSV. Downloads a spreadsheet with all contacts, notes, events, and client tags. Open in Google Sheets or send to your VA.

exports.name: Import from CSV
exports.desc: Settings → Import Contacts from CSV. Restore contacts from a previous export. Detects and skips duplicates automatically.

exports.name: Save to Phone
exports.desc: Open any contact → tap Save to Phone. Downloads a vCard with their photo. Opens in your phone's contacts app — tap to save.

exports.name: PDF Contact Brief
exports.desc: Open any contact → tap PDF Brief. Professional one-pager with photo, notes, contact intelligence, and follow-up template. Hand to your VA.

getting_started.disclaimer: FollowOp uses AI to generate communication insights, contact research, and room assessments. Results are AI-generated and may be incomplete or inaccurate. All insights should be used as a starting point — not a final conclusion. Cultural and personality assessments are generalizations. Always apply your own judgment. FollowOp and Ashé & Ember Co. are not responsible for decisions made based on AI-generated content.

whats_new.title: What's New in v1.2
whats_new.subtitle: The biggest update since launch — culturally intelligent AI, deeper contact intelligence, faster capture, smarter reporting, and a cleaner experience on every device.

differentiators.title: Culturally Intelligent AI
differentiators.desc: Most networking apps assume everyone communicates like a Western corporate professional. FollowOp does not. Our AI accounts for relationship-first cultures, high-context communication styles, cultural dress and markers, religious affiliations, and regional communication norms. Whether you are networking with a Nigerian entrepreneur, a Japanese executive, a Latin American business owner, or a Southern pastor — FollowOp gives you culturally appropriate intelligence, not a one-size-fits-all script.

differentiators.title: The Only App That Reads the Room
differentiators.desc: No other networking app lets you point your camera at a crowd and get instant intelligence on who is there, what the energy is, how to show up, and what to say first. Vibe The Room is a FollowOp original — built for people who work rooms professionally.

differentiators.title: Built for the CEO Service Model
differentiators.desc: FollowOp is the only app built specifically for professionals who represent brands in the community. Client management, weekly presence reports, special event reports, and PDF contact briefs — everything a community experience officer needs to deliver professional results and prove their value to clients.

differentiators.title: Any Image. Any Platform. Any Culture.
differentiators.desc: Scan a business card, upload a Facebook screenshot, photograph a LinkedIn profile, snap a headshot — FollowOp reads it all. No platform-specific limitations. Works with photos from any country, any culture, any background.

features.title: Culturally Intelligent Communication Analysis
features.desc: Read The Room and Research This Contact now account for cultural background, nationality, religious affiliation, and communication norms across cultures. Relationship-first cultures get relationship-first follow-up strategies. Direct cultures get direct approaches. No more Western corporate defaults.

features.title: Vibe The Room
features.desc: Take a wide photo or panorama of any room and AI delivers instant room intelligence — who is there, what the energy is, your opportunity, how to show up, and your perfect opening line. Nothing gets saved — just the intelligence. Works on every device.

features.title: Research This Contact
features.desc: AI searches the web for everything about a contact — LinkedIn, Google Business, social media, news mentions, community affiliations, and how to serve them better. Use a photo, business card, screenshot, or paste their URL. Culturally aware follow-up recommendations included.

features.title: Special Event Report
features.desc: Generate immediately after expos, pop-ups, and brand events. Auto-pulls every contact — Hot Intros first — and builds a professional client report in seconds. Copy and send within the hour.

steps.title: During — capture and tag
steps.desc: Quick Capture or Hot Intro. Select event and client. Tag contact type.

steps.title: After — generate the report
steps.desc: Dashboard → Special Event Report → select client and event → Generate.

steps.title: Send within the hour
steps.desc: Paste into email. Send to client. Their VA handles follow-ups.

features.title: PDF Contact Brief
features.desc: Export any contact as a professional one-pager — photo, contact info, notes, contact intelligence, and a follow-up template. Hand to your VA and they have everything they need to follow up on your behalf.

features.title: Import Contacts from CSV
features.desc: Restore contacts from a previous export. Settings → Import Contacts from CSV. Detects and skips duplicates automatically. Never lose your network again.

features.title: Universal Image Reading
features.desc: Now handles any image from any platform — Facebook, LinkedIn, Instagram, Twitter, TikTok, business cards, headshots, website screenshots, Google Business pages. HEIC, PNG, WebP, JPEG all supported. Gallery and camera both work.

features.title: Smarter Access & Activation
features.desc: Two-step activation — pay on Stripe, get your access code in the confirmation email, enter it in Settings. Pro now includes a 30-day free trial. Card required, cancel anytime before day 30.

roadmap.title: Video Room Analysis
roadmap.desc: True video capture for Vibe The Room — pan the room and AI reads the full scene in motion.

roadmap.title: Push Notifications
roadmap.desc: Follow-up reminders, trial ending alerts, weekly digest sent to your phone.

roadmap.title: Native App
roadmap.desc: Live QR scanning, save to camera roll, full offline mode, App Store and Google Play.

roadmap.title: Virtual Networking Mode
roadmap.desc: Paste a virtual event URL or LinkedIn Live link — AI reads the event, tells you who is likely there, and how to engage in the virtual room.

roadmap.title: Stripe Webhook
roadmap.desc: Automatic tier activation on payment — no manual code entry needed.

roadmap.title: Cloud Sync
roadmap.desc: Contacts sync across all your devices automatically.

roadmap.title: White Label
roadmap.desc: Other businesses deploy FollowOp under their own brand. Staffing agencies, real estate brokerages, chambers of commerce, marketing agencies.

roadmap.title: Direct Client Email
roadmap.desc: Send Special Event Reports, weekly and monthly reports directly to clients from inside the app. No copy-paste needed — one tap sends.

Results are AI-generated and may be incomplete, inaccurate, or not reflective of an individual's actual communication style or cultural background. Cultural and personality assessments are generalizations — not absolutes. Always apply your own judgment and direct observation. FollowOp and Ashé & Ember Co. are not responsible for decisions made based on AI-generated insights.
